in_marathi.name: Dakshith
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dedicated to God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dakshith हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dakshith is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Dakshina’, which means ‘South’, ‘Dakshinaka’, meaning ‘Southern direction’, and ‘Dakshita’, meaning ‘Dedicated to God’. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is referred to as Dakshinamurthy, who imparts wisdom and knowledge. The name Dakshith is given to a boy as a symbol of dedication to the divine and the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom.
